Kritter Klub - Animal in Crisis and Before & After Makeover! 

Looking for some animal stories? You are at the right place!

We're Korean animal lovers who have been filming critter stories from 2001 until now.
Join the klub by subscribing to our channel, 
and meet many animals who are being rescued and gets their makeover! 

*We are the official, international channel for SBS Animal*
